evals.name: infers-repository-convention-before-writing
evals.expected_output: Reads the repository's project instructions and existing work-artifact convention first. If none exists, recommends the neutral .work base. It presents one repository-relative artifact-base proposal and the exact instruction-file edit, writing nothing until the user accepts.
expectations: Reads CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, and .claude/rules before proposing a value
Preserves an existing declared repository convention instead of guessing
Recommends .work when the repository declares no convention
Writes nothing until the user accepts the value

evals.name: idempotent-reconciliation
evals.prompt: /planning:setup -- this repo already declares that work artifacts live under docs/planning.
evals.expected_output: Reports docs/planning as the effective repository artifact base and proposes no rewrite unless the user asks to change it. It does not inspect or edit pluginConfigs or plugin files.
expectations: Reports the existing repository-declared base before proposing changes
Does not rewrite an equivalent convention
Does not read or write pluginConfigs
Does not write into the plugin directory or plugin data directory

evals.name: validates-portable-project-path
evals.expected_output: Rejects the traversal path with a visible explanation because the normalized destination can escape the repository. It makes no file changes and asks for a repository-relative path without .. segments.
expectations: Rejects an artifact base containing a .. segment
Makes no file changes for an invalid path
Requires the normalized destination to remain under the repository root

evals.name: writes-tracked-project-instruction
evals.prompt:
/planning:setup

Land lifecycle artifacts in docs/planning for the whole team.
evals.expected_output: After confirmation, records docs/planning in the repository's existing work-artifact instruction surface or creates .claude/rules/work-artifacts.md. It preserves unrelated content, verifies the file is tracked, and never writes pluginConfigs or personal settings.
expectations: Persists the convention in a team-shared project instruction file
Creates .claude/rules/work-artifacts.md only when no existing instruction surface clearly owns the convention
Preserves unrelated content and verifies the instruction file is not gitignored
Does not write pluginConfigs, personal settings, or plugin files
